def transform(grid):
    """Apply the upper binary mask to the lower pattern across a solid divider."""
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    upper = grid[:split]
    lower = grid[split + 1:]
    return [[2 if upper[r][c] != 0 and lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(lower[r]))]
            for r in range(len(lower))]
